simple.summary: יְשַׂרְאֵלָה (Yᵉsarʼêlâh) means Jesarelah , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 25 14.

definitions.full: H3480. Yesarelah יְשַׂרְאֵ֫לָה proper name, masculine a son of Asaph 1Chr 25:14 = אֲשַׂראֵ֫לָה (q. v.) 25:2 (etymology dubious).
definitions.rootNote: by variation from 3477 and 410 with directive enclitic; right towards God;
